```{r}
data = c(35, 42, 33, 26, 18, 38, 28, 23, 29, 24)
n = 10
alpha =0.05 
df = n -1
s = sd(data)
(U_chisq_cvalue = qchisq(1-alpha/2, df ))
(L_chisq_cvalue = qchisq(alpha/2, df))
Upper = (n-1)*s^2/L_chisq_cvalue
Lower = (n-1)*s^2/U_chisq_cvalue
Upper
Lower 
sqrt(Lower)
sqrt(Upper)

```
